controllerOutcome.objective:
创建一个独立的单文件 HTML 页面 pelican-bicycle.html，使用内联 SVG + CSS/JS 实现一个 2D 动画：一只鹈鹕骑自行车。

必须满足的要求：
1. 文件为单个自包含 HTML（根目录文件名精确为 pelican-bicycle.html），不依赖任何外部网络资源（无外链 CDN、无外链字体、无外链图片），所有样式与脚本内联。
2. 画面主体用 SVG 绘制，需可辨识：鹈鹕（大喙+喉囊、长颈、身体、翅膀、腿）与自行车（两个车轮及辐条、车架、车把、脚踏曲柄、鞍座）。
3. 动画为连续循环的 2D 动画，至少包含：车轮旋转、脚踏曲柄转动、鹈鹕腿部随之踩踏、身体/头部轻微上下起伏，整体给人“骑车前进”的感觉；可选加入背景景物横向滚动以增强前进感。
4. 动画使用 CSS 动画或 requestAnimationFrame/SMIL 任一实现，不得依赖外部库；循环无跳变（首尾衔接自然）。
5. 页面在浏览器中直接打开即可运行，无需构建步骤；无 JS 报错。
6. 具备基本可用性：合理 viewBox 与自适应尺寸（随窗口缩放不溢出）、语义化 SVG 结构（分组、可读的 id/注释）。
7. 建议支持 prefers-reduced-motion：在用户开启减少动态效果时降低或暂停动画（不强制，但为加分项）。

验收标准：
- 文件存在于项目根目录且文件名精确为 pelican-bicycle.html。
- HTML 结构完整（doctype、html、head、body 齐全），标签闭合正确，无未闭合标签。
- 内联 SVG 存在且包含车轮、车架、鹈鹕喙/身体等可辨识元素。
- 存在可运行的动画定义（CSS keyframes 或 JS/SMIL），且车轮旋转与曲柄/腿部踩踏运动同时存在。
- 无任何指向外部域的 src/href/url() 资源引用。
- 不引用未定义的外部脚本或样式，页面独立可运行。

quality.summary: Independent quality review of `pelican-bicycle.html` confirms the deliverable meets the specified acceptance criteria. The single self-contained HTML file exists in the project root with the exact required filename, contains a complete `<!DOCTYPE html>` document with `<html>`, `<head>`, and `<body>`, and embeds an inline SVG depicting a recognizable pelican (beak, throat pouch, long neck, body, wing, legs) and a bicycle (two spoked wheels, frame, handlebar, saddle, crank/pedals). CSS `@keyframes` drive simultaneous, seamless looping animations for wheel rotation, crank rotation, leg pedaling, body bobbing, and optional background/road parallax scrolling. The page is responsive (`viewBox`, `width: 100%`, `max-height: 78vh`, `preserveAspectRatio`), includes semantic SVG grouping with readable ids/comments, and supports `prefers-reduced-motion`. No external resources (CDN, fonts, images, stylesheets, scripts) are referenced; all `url()` references are local SVG fragment references. Inline JavaScript syntax validated successfully with Node’s `vm.Script`. A custom Node-based quality gate was executed in `$TMPDIR` and passed; the supplied evidence script was also reproduced and passed.
evidence: File exists at project root with exact name: `pelican-bicycle.html` (20,056 bytes).
HTML structure validated: DOCTYPE, `<html>`, `<head>`, `<body>` present and tag nesting is balanced (verified via heuristic that skips `<style>`/`<script>` content).
No external references: grep for `src|href` pointing off-domain, external `url()`, `@import`, `integrity`, or `crossorigin` returned no matches.
Inline-only scripts/styles confirmed: no `<script src=...>` or `<link rel="stylesheet" ...>`; only local `url(#id)` SVG references.

SVG required elements present: pelican ids `beak`, `pouch`, `neck`, `body`, `wing`, `leg-near`, `leg-far`, `head`; bicycle ids `wheel-front`, `wheel-rear`, `frame`, `handlebar`, `saddle`, `crank`; spoke groups `spokes-front` and `spokes-rear`.

Animations present and applied: `@keyframes spin`, `bob`, `pedal-near`, `pedal-far`; applied via CSS to wheel rotors, crank rotor, pelican bob, and both legs. Background/road parallax layers also present.

Seamless loops verified mathematically: rotation keyframes return to 0°, translate keyframes return to origin, background tiles and road dashes are duplicated with exact tile/period offsets (400, 500, 300, 160 units).
`prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` media query present and JavaScript additionally synchronizes reduced-motion preference and visibility-state pausing.
JavaScript syntax validated: inline script compiled successfully with Node `vm.Script`; no syntax errors.
No SVG transform/CSS transform animation conflict: rotors targeted by CSS rotation have no SVG `transform` attribute; positioning transforms live on parent wrapper groups.
Executed custom Node quality gate at `$TMPDIR/pelican-quality-check.js`: `All quality checks passed.`
Reproduced supplied evidence script at `$TMPDIR/reproduce-evidence.js`: `Reproduced evidence check passed.`
limitations: No headless or interactive browser is available in this runtime (`browserAvailable: false`), so actual rendered frame correctness, animation smoothness, and precise visual layering (e.g., far leg behind frame) were not empirically observed. Assessment is based on static code analysis and Node-level validation only.
Accessibility of the pedaling motion for users with vestibular disorders was only verified structurally (media query exists), not tested with an actual reduced-motion OS/browser setting.

qualityGate.persona: 加载 kimi-code-quality-gate。你是独立质量审查者，按原始用户目标检查实际代码、运行必要测试、检查功能覆盖和回归。补充测试写入 $TMPDIR。返回 passed、failed 或 blocked，提供实际命令、结果和需要修复的问题。
